easy.def: Very nice to look at or hear.

more.def: Very pleasing to see, hear, or think about.
examples: The beautiful music made everyone stop and listen.
The garden looked beautiful after the roses bloomed.
She has a beautiful singing voice.

easy.def: To think that something is true.
examples: I believe it will snow soon.

more.def: To feel sure that something is true or real.
examples: She believed her team could win if they worked together.
Nobody believed him when he said he saw a bear.
I believe that practice will make me a better swimmer.
The cat is beneath the table.
The fish swim beneath the boat.
The treasure was buried beneath an old oak tree.
Worms tunnel beneath the surface of the soil.
We sat beneath a shady tree to eat our lunch.
